kultivator.screen.help.peta_dunia.title: World Map
kultivator.screen.help.peta_dunia: An ink map on old paper: open it from Scroll › World › Map, the [[key:peta]] key, /kultivasi peta, or a World Map scroll (paper + ink sac + Low Spirit Stone). Land within 96 blocks of where you walk comes out of the fog; sect mates share the same map. Sites show only after you found them (standing near, teahouse rumours, a Pointer Scroll, or trading maps: two map holders right-click each other). Live omens (treasure pillars, meteors, dragons) show around you. Your sect hall's territory, your sect mates' and halls you have seen show as coloured circles; NPC sect domains carry inked borders and red seals. The Weather, Sky, Seals and Route coins switch overlays. Drag to pan, the wheel for three zooms (1 pixel = 16 / 64 / 256 blocks), click a marker for its card; a ship's captain can Sail there at once; right-click sets a waypoint (at most 32). Source: Shan Hai Jing; inspired by the Mountain and Sea Realm of I Shall Seal the Heavens.
kultivator.screen.help.dunia_luas.title: The Wide World
kultivator.screen.help.dunia_luas: The new world is wider: Cultivator Towns with auction houses, teahouses and black markets; wandering cultivators and rival groups; ancestral cave ruins with formation puzzles; ancient demon prisons whose seals can break; the Hundred-Floor Tower; random sky events, treasure births and Qi mist; wild dragons and spirit beast evolution; the Underworld, the Boundless Sea and the Immortal City. New buildings only appear in newly generated chunks; otherwise no block ever changes (Destruction Mode stays the only way). The World Map records all you find and flying ships carry you far. Chapters 3 and 13 of the Guide Book lead the way; every system can be switched off in config/kultivator-dunia.json.
Open the World Map of Cultivation.
